# Generated by go run ./cmd/compose --kms from the key service's source. Don't edit by hand.
#
# The Tacy key service: one container, kmsd, holding the master key in memory only. Its image is the pinned
# distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13@sha256:2293b36c7c9082bf4115aab724b4d2cddec82c8eba39bf27ac0517e159acf150)
# plus one layer with /tacy/kmsd (linux/amd64, sha256 c6d1b8b2c9e6840a3e3cc28339e7f015cb1f6b0e19a9b9e12a21a635c38f1498).
# No volumes but dstack's socket (its own quotes), no environment, logging off, no swap.
services:
  kmsd:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/kmsd@sha256:c89c32714b8361349d10acbb47360f333a2e60041796fcf7a3ab8ea3fca574f8
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/kmsd"]
    command: ["-listen", ":8000", "-admin-keys", "ed25519:9ZU78UPBF2w6xfjTdSGODr5lQD7kTrt0SuLhTl+kOv8=", "-admin-threshold", "1", "-role", "primary"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "10005:10005"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    logging:
      driver: none
    mem_limit: 512m
    memswap_limit: 512m
    ulimits:
      core: 0
name: tacy-kms
